title: Bendix employee captured by the Tupamaros in Uruguay

tellings.quote: We had a guy, we lost a guy in Uruguay, uh was captured by the Tupamaros um right out of his office and I believe he was killed.

plain: In the 1970s, a man working for Bendix, an American aerospace and electronics company, is said to have been taken straight from his office in Uruguay by the Tupamaros, an armed left-wing group there. The writer Peter Levenda, billed as a historian of the CIA, tells it as something he heard, and says he believes the man was killed.
